title: Real Estate Marketing & Admin VA (OMs, BOVs, Social Media) — Long-Term
description:
We're a commercial real estate business looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, long-term virtual assistant to support our marketing and day-to-day operations. We value clear communication, consistency, and someone who takes pride in polished, professional work. If you're looking for a stable ongoing role (not one-off gigs), we'd love to hear from you.



HOURS & SCHEDULE

~20 hours per week to start, with room to grow. We can be flexible on scheduling, but we need consistent weekly availability and prefer someone who can work our business hours. We are located in Los Angeles, CA. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Create and lay out Offering Memorandums (OMs) and Broker Opinions of Value (BOVs) using our templates. We are currently            using Adobe Indesign, and Claude Design. 

• Design and schedule content for Instagram and LinkedIn

• Edit property and listing photos (cleanup, cropping, enhancement)

• Handle general administrative tasks (data entry, research, file/document organization,
 and calendar support)



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Strong graphic design skills — InDesign, Photoshop, Adobe Creative Cloud a big plus

• Excellent written English and clear, prompt communication

• Highly organized and detail-oriented; you catch small mistakes

• Dependable and able to commit to consistent weekly hours long-term

• Real estate marketing experience (OMs, BOVs, flyers, brochures) is a strong bonus — but if you're a great designer and quick learner, we're happy to train you on the real estate side



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with commercial real estate specifically

• Familiarity with a CRM and social media scheduling tools



HOW TO APPLY

Please start your application with the word SKYLINE so we know you read the full post. Then include:

1. A short intro about yourself and your relevant experience

2. A link to your portfolio (please highlight any real estate or marketing materials)

3. The design tools you're most comfortable in

4. Your available hours and time zone

5. Your expected monthly rate for ~20 hours/week



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a small PAID test project so we can see how we work together before committing to a long-term arrangement. We look forward to reading your application!

title: PR PITCH WRITER (HARO, Qwoted, Featured, SOS)
description:
Web Moves is a boutique digital marketing agency with decades of service specializing in inbound marketing and SEO.



We are looking to hire a highly skilled Digital PR writer who can write organic, informative, and thoughtful copy with a short turnaround time for any of the following topics on a long-term basis:



-Real estate and property management

-Precious metals, gems, and jewelry

-Business management, administration, leadership, and marketing

-Promotional products, events, and brand activation

-Home maintenance, pest control, insects/bugs, and extermination

-Home entertainment, audio/video, home theatre, film, music

-Health, medicine, pain management, wellness, pharmacology, and similar

-Other topics (please mention specialized backgrounds, experience, qualification you may have in other fields)



Pay and Benefits: Payment is either hourly or by piece/word count, please share your preference(s) and what you’re open to. We’re looking for someone who can work around 20 hours per week, and the base hourly rate is $6. Stronger candidates may be offered more. After a successful first year of consistent positive performance, you will be provided a 13th month Holiday Bonus which will be an average of all your months’ total pays.





Please read through areas A through and, in your application, include answers and confirmation for each area.



A) Confirm you meet these Requirements/Focus Areas:



1. Strong English at native written level or higher. Writer should be able to adjust written style between various formalities, tones, and for different audiences.

2. Zero use or dependency with AI. We provide clients with an AI-free experience and therefore cannot compensate any writer for any AI-generated content, text, or phrase. We use a proprietary AI-detection protocol that all submitted work is subject to. If you dislike what AI is doing to our industry, you’ll likely be a good fit for this role!

3. Ability to write under time constraints. Many of our PR opportunities have fast and hard deadlines.

4. Reliable communication. Writers have to coordinate and keep in touch with the team. A lack of communication on a daily basis would not be a good fit for this role.



B) Confirm you can meet this Role Schedule: Write daily online Monday-Thursday with at least one hour available from 9am-5pm Eastern Time for team check-in and communication. Fridays are optional and other work hours are flexible per your preference/needs.



C) Confirm acceptance of these Performance Benchmarks:

1. Weekly written volume (words, memos written, etc)

2. Placement rate (how much of your work results in a placement for a client)

3. Communication regularity and promptness

4. Writing speed (how responsive are you once opportunities are live)



D) State PR platforms you’re familiar with and how much experience you have (if any): ?Examples: HARO, Qwoted, SOS, Featured, Connectively, Source Bottle, etc



E) Summarize your philosophy as you approach this kind of work (which standards are most important to uphold, what makes you happy/unhappy in a job like this, what kind of volume/output/team environment do you thrive in, where do you see the future of this work going?)



F) Confirm you are willing to abide by a strict No-AI policy for all submitted copy and that you are willing to do your best to help us ensure our output is as organic and AI-proof as possible. Our entire team’s success, at every level, depends on integrity and transparency in order to survive.

Premium Australian Jewellery Brand



About Us



Prism & Pearl is an Australian premium moissanite jewellery brand.

We create beautiful, high quality jewellery for women who want luxury, sparkle and sophistication without the traditional diamond price tag.

Our products are live.

Our website is live.

Our ecommerce foundations are in place.

Now we are focused on the next stage.

Growing the brand, acquiring customers and generating revenue.

We are looking for an Ecommerce Growth Marketing Manager who can help us build a profitable ecommerce business from the ground up.

Website:

:

Our Primary Goal



This role exists for one reason.

To help grow revenue through effective marketing.

We are not looking for someone to simply manage social media accounts or create marketing plans.

We are looking for someone who understands how marketing activities contribute to business growth.

Every piece of content,
 campaign, paid advertisement, promotion and customer journey should be designed with one objective in mind.

Generating more customers and more sales.

The Role

• What marketing activities should happen

• What improvements should be made to increase conversions and sales

Your role is to help direct and coordinate marketing initiatives that drive growth.

Growth & Revenue

What Success Looks Like

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Job Title: AI Video Editor – Storytelling Videos for TikTok (Script-to-Video)



About the Role

I run a TikTok affiliate account in Germany. I need someone to turn my scripts into finished AI-generated storytelling videos. Each video tells a story with a product reveal. I provide the script and mostly a reference Video. You produce the video in this style with your generated clips.



This is short-form content (TikTok, 9:16). German voiceover. Starts with a paid trial task – if quality is right, this becomes ongoing work.



Reference style – watch these first:





This is the exact style and quality level I want. Story-driven, AI-generated visuals, clean editing, product appears.



Workflow per video

1. I send you a script or a Video (english or german) + product info

2. You generate AI video clips matching the story (use any tool that gets the result: Veo 3, Kling, Runway, Hailuo, Freepik, etc.)

3. You generate the German script & voiceover in ElevenLabs

4. You edit everything in CapCut: cuts, transitions, sound effects, bg music

5. You deliver the final MP4, 9:16, ready to post



Requirements

- Real hands-on experience with AI video tools – you understand prompting, character consistency, how to fix common AI issues

- CapCut skills: timing, pacing, captions, sound design

- ElevenLabs or similar voiceover experience

- You can match a reference style

- Decent written English (we communicate in English)

- German is NOT required – the script and voiceover are in German, but you don't need to speak it. You just need to follow the script timing and sync captions correctly.



Pay

$3 per finished video. Weekly payout via PayPal.

Test batch first. Volume scales up if quality and speed are good.



How to apply

contact me on Whatsapp 
and send:

1. Short intro about you + your AI video experience

2. 2-3 examples of AI videos or short-form edits you've made (links)

3. Which AI video tools you've actually used

4. Turnaround time per video (script + Video received -- final delivery)





Applications without examples or without answering questions will be ignored.



Looking forward to your application.

Our company sells a variety of informational products: books, courses, and memberships related to relationships.

What do we need from our Xero accountant?

title: Ecommerce Creative Strategist
description:
ROLE

This position is responsible for researching, conceiving, and producing direct-response ad creatives (static image ads and short video ads) for our European e-commerce brands, and for iterating on winners based on real performance data. You are not a brand designer — you are a direct-response marketer who can also execute the design and editing yourself. Every creative you make exists to sell, and you will see the numbers that prove whether it did.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• You will research each product and its customer before designing anything: who buys it, what pain drives them, what they have already tried, and what they need to believe before they buy

• You will mine competitor ads and swipe files 
 Ad Library and similar) to identify proven angles, hooks, and formats worth testing

• You will write creative briefs built on customer awareness levels and pain intensity — matching the hook and angle to where the audience sits (problem aware, solution aware, product aware)

• You will design static image ads: pack-shot/benefit statics, before-and-after concepts, comparison ads, testimonial-style and editorial-style images

• You will edit short direct-response video ads for
/Instagram feeds: hook-first cuts, captions, product demos, testimonial-style edits

• You will produce creatives in batches for testing — multiple distinct angles per batch, not five variations of the same idea

• You will study performance data with the media buyer (CTR, CPA, ROAS, frequency/fatigue) and iterate: double down on winning angles, kill losing ones, refresh fatigued winners without losing what made them work

• You will adapt winning creatives across markets and languages (working with translation workflows — you do not need to speak the languages)

• You will keep the creative pipeline organized: every batch named, filed, and tracked from "made" to "launched"

• Attend weekly meetings

• Be pro-active and take initiative for the benefit of the team and the company

• Perform any task assigned by immediate supervisor/manager



RESULTS

• A consistent volume of test-ready creative batches shipped every week, on or before the due date

• Each batch contains genuinely distinct angles mapped to awareness levels — not cosmetic variations

• Winning ads iterated and refreshed before fatigue kills them; losing angles killed without ego

• Creative performance improves over time: rising hook rates/CTR and more winners per batch

• Achieve targeted KPIs (batches shipped, test win rate, winner longevity)



REQUIREMENTS

• 2+ years producing ad creatives for e-commerce / direct-response brands 
/Instagram/TikTok ads — you can show ads YOU made that spent real money)

• Strong graphic design skills (Photoshop/Figma/Canva or equivalent) — you execute your own concepts

• Solid video editing skills (Premiere/CapCut/After Effects or equivalent) — hook-first, caption-heavy, feed-native editing

• Working knowledge of direct-response fundamentals: Eugene Schwartz’s Breakthrough Advertising, the five levels of customer awareness, market sophistication, and matching message to pain intensity

• Ability to read basic ad metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, frequency) and change creative decisions because of them

• Strong written English for hooks, headlines, and ad copy drafts



Competences

• Direct-response instinct: every creative exists to sell

• Extreme Attention to Detail

• Extremely Organised

• Excellent Written and Verbal Communication Skills

• Timely Completion Of Tasks (very responsible)

• Zero ego about killed creatives — the data d

• Highly committed professional and Loyal

• Proactivity

• Teamwork

• Adaptability

• Ability to follow instructions

• A proactive and flexible approach to work



Marketing Requirements

• Working knowledge of e-commerce / direct-response advertising (mandatory)

• Understanding of Breakthrough Advertising concepts: awareness levels, sophistication stages, mass desire (mandatory — we test for this)

• Experience with advertorial / listicle-style funnels (nice to have)

• Experience creating UGC-style video ads (nice to have)



Technology Requirements

• Photoshop/Figma/Canva (mandatory) and Premiere/CapCut or equivalent (mandatory)

• Knowledge Of Mac And PC

• Reliable Internet Connection

• Reliable Phone



Hours & Pay

• Part-time 20hrs/week 

• $600/month depending on experience

• Starts with a paid trial project before we commit long-term



How to apply  (read carefully — this is part of the test)

1. Start your application with the word "BLUEPRINT" so we know you read the whole post.

2. Attach or link a portfolio of AD CREATIVES you personally made that ran with real ad spend (not brand/logo work). For your best one, tell us in 2–3 sentences: what the angle was, who it targeted, and how it performed.

3. Answer this: "A product’s best ad has run for 3 weeks and is fatiguing (frequency climbing, CTR falling). Walk us through how you would refresh it — what would you keep, what would you change, and why?"

4. In one sentence each, explain the difference between a PROBLEM-AWARE and a PRODUCT-AWARE audience, and how the ad hook changes between them.

5. (Optional but preferred) A 60–90 second Loom introducing yourself.

Core Functions of the Role

Review completed OASIS assessments (SOC, ROC, Recert, Discharge)

Validate accuracy of functional scores, cognition, and clinical data

Check consistency with chart notes and visit documentation

Ensure compliance with CMS rules and submission standards



OASIS drives:

• Medicare payment

• Quality reporting

• Compliance audits



(Source: OASIS is federally mandated for home health assessment and payment)

 

Home Health Workforce

Assign correct diagnosis codes based on documentation

Ensure primary diagnosis supports home health eligibility

Capture comorbidities for reimbursement under PDGM

Prevent claim denials due to incorrect coding

Review physician orders and care plans (Form 485)

Check if:

Visit frequency is correct

Discipline orders match patient needs

Diagnoses align with OASIS and ICD-10 codes

Ensure documentation supports Medicare Conditions of Participation

4. Quality Assurance (QA Support)

Identify documentation errors from clinicians (nurses, therapists)

Provide correction feedback (clarification requests)

Maintain audit-ready charts

? 95?curacy target

Low claim denial risk

Cleared for billing submission

Performance Standards (KPIs)

title: Remote Administrative Assistant
description:
This isn’t a VA job. This is a career.



Virtuoso builds team members who direct AI, not people replaced by it.



You’ll work with real businesses, solve real problems, and grow into someone they can rely on. If you want to take ownership, sharpen your thinking, and become more valuable over time, keep reading.



## About Virtuoso



Virtuoso builds remote team members for real businesses. People who think clearly, communicate well, use AI with judgment, and own their work.



We don’t rent team members. We build them.



You will not just be hired to finish random tasks. You will be trained, coached, and matched with client work where your judgment, reliability, and ability to learn matter.



We are looking for people who want to grow into stronger remote professionals. Not people who only want short-term task work.



## About the role



This is a remote business support role.



One thing to know up front: you will be placed inside one of our client companies. Your daily work, your manager, and the people you help are on the client side. Virtuoso trains you, stays close to you, and keeps your skills growing the whole way.



And the goal is bigger than a placement. You work with your client. You earn your AI Passport with us and learn to direct AI. After about 12 months, the goal is for your client to hire you directly. You become part of their team for the long term. That is what success looks like here.



Your work will depend on your strengths and the client need. You may support one or more areas:



* Admin and operations

* Customer support

* Marketing support

* Scheduling and coordination

* Finance or bookkeeping support

* Client communication

* Research and follow-up work

* Process documentation



You do not need to be strong in every category. During the application process, we will look at how you think, how you communicate, what you can already do, and where you may be the best fit.



## What you may do



Your day-to-day work may include:



* Organizing tasks, files, notes, calendars, or follow-ups

* Communicating with clients, customers, or internal team members

* Helping with admin, operations, customer service, marketing, or finance support

* Drafting
s, documents, summaries, or updates

* Using AI tools to help research, organize, draft, or improve work

* Checking AI output before using it

* Asking clear questions when something is unclear

* Following instructions while still using good judgment

* Improving documents, systems, and processes over time



## How you grow here



You do not need to come in knowing everything.



The Virtuoso AI Passport is what makes you exceptional at this work — not just trained for a role. You earn it before you are matched with a client. It stays with you. It is proof that you can think clearly and use AI with judgment.



Virtuoso builds you up in:



* Clear communication

* Better work habits

* Responsible AI use

* How to check and improve your own work

* How to think through unclear tasks

* How to receive and apply feedback

* How to become more useful to a real business



AI is part of the work. AI is not the answer.



We care about how you think and the choices you make. We do not care how well you copy an AI answer.



## Who succeeds here



You are a strong fit if you:



* Take ownership of your work

* Finish what you start. You would rather hand back something done than something started

* Communicate clearly and honestly

* Notice details and care about doing things well

* Can follow instructions without needing every small step explained

* Ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear

* Are open to feedback and willing to improve

* Are curious about AI and willing to learn how to use it well

* Can explain your thinking, not just submit an answer

* Want long-term growth, not just a quick side job

* Only want simple task work

* Do not like feedback

* Need someone to tell you every step before you move

* Use AI without checking the answer

* Want a short-term gig only

* Do not enjoy learning new tools or improving your work

* Prefer to work fast even when the quality is not strong



## Work setup



This is a remote role for Philippines-based applicants.



You will need:



* A reliable computer

* Stable internet

* A quiet place to work

* Strong written communication

* Willingness to learn new tools and follow the Virtuoso process



Schedule, pay, and client match details will be confirmed during the hiring process.

title: Direct Response Video Editor — DTC/Ecom Supplement Ads
description:
IF YOU JUST SEND ME YOUR RESUME I WILL IGNORE





We're a fast-growing DTC supplement brand running high-volume paid social (Meta/TikTok). Looking for editors to join full-time who already gets direct response — not someone we have to train on pacing or hook structure.



What you'll be doing:

Editing AI UGC and VSL-style ad creatives — hook-driven openers, fast retention pacing, pattern interrupts, on-screen text/captions timed to the script, clean cuts that keep watch time up. Typically 3 hook variations cut against one core body per concept.



This is direct response editing, not content editing:



Every cut serves retention and conversion, not aesthetics. That means: the hook has to land in the first 1-3 seconds or the edit has failed regardless of how "nice" it looks; cuts and pattern interrupts are placed to fight drop-off at the exact points people scroll away, not on a rhythm; proof, objection-handling, and mechanism sections get sequenced and paced deliberately, not just trimmed for length; text-on-screen reinforces the spoken hook instead of just captioning it; and pacing tightens or loosens based on awareness stage of the hook (a cold problem-unaware hook needs different pacing than a warm retargeting angle). If you edit for "flow" the way a general content editor does, this isn't the right fit — we need someone editing for the metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR), not for how it feels to watch.



You need:



Real, verifiable experience editing ads for a DTC/ecom brand — not general content or YouTube/vlog editing



Supplement, health, or wellness brand experience specifically — you understand claims-adjacent pacing and how these ads are structured to hold attention through a mechanism/proof section



A working understanding of direct response principles: why the hook exists, why pacing tightens in the first 3 seconds, how proof and objection-handling get sequenced, and how awareness stage changes pacing decisions

Experience with competitor-inspired ad structures / creative testing at volume

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 70,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing tea
mbers who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or tea
ntoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: Proofreader & Editor for K–3 Educational Resources (Former Teacher / Curriculum Developer)
description:
We're a growing US-based educational resources company. We create K–3 phonics, reading, math, and writing materials used by hundreds of thousands of teachers. Our resources have to be perfect before they go live — every worksheet, every answer key, every slide.



We're looking for a sharp editorial eye to be the final gate before our resources publish. You'll proofread and edit finished materials, catch what everyone else missed, fix problems directly in the files, and review the work our production team hands you. This is a detail person's dream job, and a sloppy person's nightmare.



What you'll do

- Proofread finished resources — catch typos, grammar, inconsistent formatting, wrong answers in answer keys, mismatched headers, and anything that looks off.

- Make final edits directly in PowerPoint — fix a text box that overflows, a graphic that's misaligned, an off-brand font, a broken answer slide. Correct the file cleanly and hand it back publish-ready. (This is corrective editing of resources our team builds — not designing new resources from scratch.)

- Review the team's work — check what our production people produce against our standards before it goes live, and send back what doesn't pass.

- Get resources publish-ready — run each resource through a final QA pass so it's clean, consistent, and ready to sell with zero errors.





You are the last set of eyes. If something wrong reaches a customer, it got past you — and we're hiring you because you don't let things get past you.



Who you are (must-haves)

- Background as an English teacher OR curriculum developer. This is required. We need someone who doesn't just catch typos, but understands what a K–3 resource is supposed to do — so you'll spot a confusing instruction, an answer key that doesn't match the worksheet, or content that's pitched at the wrong grade level.

Native-level or near-native written English. Precise, confident, correct.

- Genuinely comfortable in PowerPoint. You can go into a slide, fix a layout problem, and leave the rest of the file untouched. Working with brand fonts, templates, and master slides doesn't scare you.

- Extreme attention to detail. You notice the thing on the fifth page that everyone else scrolled past.

Windows-based setup with a reliable computer and internet.

- Reliable, communicative, and able to follow a standard precisely — you respect templates and brand guidelines rather than improvising.





Nice to have (not required)

Experience with TeachersPayTeachers (TPT), Etsy, or educational publishing.

Familiarity with the Science of Reading, UFLI, phonics, or K–3 curriculum.

Basic Canva skills.



Our hiring process (please read — this is a serious editorial role)

Because this job is the quality bar, we hire on demonstrated skill, not résumés. Every candidate we shortlist will complete two short paid tests:



1. A proofreading test — a set of pages with planted errors. We want to see what you catch.

2. An editorial + PowerPoint test — a real resource slide with problems you'll need to fix in the file and hand back clean, plus a piece you'll need to rewrite for clarity.



Both are paid. They take real effort, and they tell us far more than an interview would. If a rigorous, standards-driven process excites you, you'll love it here. If it doesn't, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

To show us you read to the end (and that you follow instructions precisely — a core part of this job), please do the following:



Start your application with the word PHONICS in all caps.

Briefly describe your experience as an English teacher or curriculum developer.

Attach your portfolio.

Tell us how comfortable you are working directly in PowerPoint, with an example of the kind of file work you've done.



Applications that don't start with PHONICS won't be reviewed.



We're excited to meet the person who's going to be our last, best set of eyes.

title: Financial Controller
description:
# Financial Controller (Remote – International)



**Location:** Remote (International)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time



## Join a Company That's Building What's Next



For more than 25 years, Display Sales has helped cities, schools, and businesses create memorable spaces through commercial holiday décor, banners, flags, and custom display solutions.



Today, we're entering an exciting new chapter. Under new ownership, we're modernizing our systems, improving operations, and building a scalable business positioned for significant growth over the next several years.



We're looking for an experienced **Financial Controller** who wants to do more than manage accounting. We want a strategic finance partner who enjoys building processes, improving reporting, and helping leadership make better business decisions.



**This role requires significant hands-on experience with Sage Intacct.** We're looking for someone who can step in, own our accounting operations, optimize our financial systems, and help build the financial infrastructure for our next stage of growth.



If you're energized by ownership, continuous improvement, and working directly with executives in a fast-growing business, we'd love to meet you.



---



# About the Role



The Financial Controller will lead Display Sales' finance and accounting function while serving as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team.



This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, internal controls, financial analysis, accounting operations, and continuous process improvement.



You'll work directly with leadership to provide accurate financial information, improve visibility into business performance, and help build scalable financial processes that support long-term growth.



---



# Key Responsibilities



### Financial Leadership



* Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process.

* Prepare accurate financial statements and executive reporting packages.

* Manage the general ledger and oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and accounting operations.

* Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and maintain strong internal controls.

* Coordinate annual audits and work with external accounting and tax partners.



### Financial Planning & Analysis



* Develop annual budgets and rolling forecasts.

* Prepare weekly and monthly cash flow forecasts.

* Analyze profitability by product line, customer, and business segment.

* Build KPI dashboards and executive reporting for leadership.

* Monitor financial performance and identify opportunities to improve margins and efficiency.



### Strategic Business Partnership



* Partner directly with the CEO and leadership team on financial planning and business decisions.

* Support pricing strategy, margin analysis, and profitability initiatives.

* Provide financial analysis for strategic projects, investments, and future acquisitions.

* Identify financial risks and opportunities before they become issues.



### Systems & Process Improvement



* Maintain and optimize Sage Intacct.

* Improve accounting workflows and financial reporting processes.

* Help automate manual processes through technology and AI where appropriate.

* Partner with leadership to improve system integrations and reporting capabilities.



---



# Required Qualifications



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

* **Required: 5+ years of hands-on Sage Intacct experience, including financial reporting, month-end close, general ledger management, and system administration.**

* 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.

* Previous experience as a Financial Controller, Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Finance Manager.

* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

* Experience preparing budgets, forecasts, cash flow projections, and executive reporting.

* Experience improving accounting processes and internal controls.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Ability to overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.

* Experience supporting executive leadership in a growing business.



---



# Preferred Qualifications



* CPA or equivalent professional accounting designation.

* Experience working remotely with U.S.-based companies.

* Experience in wholesale, distribution, manufacturing, or inventory-based businesses.

* Experience with Salesforce or CRM integrations.

* Experience implementing automation and AI within finance operations.



---



# You'll Thrive Here If You...



* Think like a business partner—not just an accountant.

* Enjoy building systems instead of simply maintaining them.

* Take ownership without waiting to be asked.

* Communicate confidently with senior leaders.

* Balance attention to detail with strategic thinking.

* Are naturally curious and always looking for better ways to improve processes.

* Enjoy working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.



---



# Working with Display Sales



Although this is a fully remote international position, you'll be an important member of our leadership team—not an outsourced accountant.



You'll work directly with our CEO and leadership team, helping guide financial decisions, improve reporting, and build scalable processes as the business grows.



Success in this role requires:



* Excellent English communication skills.

* Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.

* The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a remote team.

* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

* A commitment to accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



---



# Why Display Sales?



At Display Sales, your work will have a direct impact on the future of the company.



We're a growing business where great ideas are welcomed, continuous improvement is encouraged, and every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.



Our values guide everything we do:



* Positive Attitude

* Respect

* Prioritization

* Customer Focus

* Communication

* Excellence

* Growth Mindset



We're looking for someone who shares these values and wants to help build something exceptional.



---



# What We Offer



* Competitive compensation based on experience.

* Fully remote position.

* Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based company.

* Direct collaboration with executive leadership.

* High level of ownership and autonomy.

* Opportunities to improve systems and shape the future of our finance function.

* Professional development and career growth as the company continues to expand.

* A collaborative, respectful, and supportive team culture.



---



# Ready to Build With Us?



We're looking for someone who wants to make a meaningful impact—not simply maintain the accounting function.



If you're excited about helping build a growing company while partnering directly with leadership, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply today and help shape the next chapter of Display Sales.

title: Wholesaling Lead Manager
description:
About the Role

Anchor Home Advisors is a real estate investment company that helps homeowners sell their properties quickly and hassle-free. Every day, motivated sellers reach out to us — and the speed and quality of our response determines whether we win the deal or lose it to a competitor.



The Lead Manager is the first human voice a seller hears and the engine of our pipeline. You own every new lead from the moment it comes in: responding fast, building rapport, qualifying motivation, and setting a quality appointment for our acquisitions team. Your north-star belief is simple — every new seller lead is a HOT lead, and we never lose a hot lead.

Core mindset: Right Person + Right Mindset + Right Timing + Right Method. The first person to have a meaningful conversation with a seller has the best shot at the deal.



What You’ll Do

Speed to Lead & First Contact

• Maintain a 90%+ live-answer rate — answer inbound calls immediately whenever possible.

• Call back missed calls within 2 minutes and respond to web leads within seconds.

• Treat urgency as your edge: assume every seller is also talking to competitors, and be the one who reaches them first.

Lead Qualification & Rapport

• Run the cold-call framework: strong opening, discovery questions, relationship building, and appointment-setting close.

• Uncover the seller’s true situation and motivation — the reason for selling, timeline, and biggest challenges.

• Apply the JHB Method on every conversation: Join Forces (build genuine rapport), Hear the seller’s needs, and Build a solution around what matters to them.

• Capture the seller’s initial price expectations (“kite price”) and key details for the acquisitions team.

• Listen more than you talk. Be conversational, not transactional.

Follow-Up & Pipeline Management

• Work the 10-day sequence — for any lead you can’t reach, call, text, voi
, and
 up to 3 times a day, rotating morning, afternoon, and evening.

• Skip-trace additional phone numbers and, when appropriate, arrange to stop by the property the same day.

• Nurture long-term leads (30+ days) with weekly check-ins, monthly market-update
s, and personal follow-up when a seller’s motivation changes.

• Keep every lead accurately logged and updated in the CRM so nothing falls through the cracks.

Appointment Setting

• Set high-quality appointments with the goal of a one-call close in mind — get to the property as fast as possible to close the time gap.

• Think five steps ahead: confirm all decision-makers will be present and surface any competing offers before the appointment.

• Confirm appointments in advance and prep the acquisitions team with everything they need to walk in ready.

• Overcome common objections (“Just give me a ballpark,” “I’m busy,” “I want other offers”) with empathy and calibrated questions rather than pressure.

What We’re Looking For

The right person to talk with sellers is:

• Warm and welcoming — genuinely enjoys talking with people.

• Detail-oriented and organized.

• A strong listener who hears more than they say.

• Coachable and process-driven, willing to follow a proven system and scripts.

• Resilient and persistent — comfortable with high call volume and consistent follow-up.

• Calm under pressure and quick to respond with urgency.

Qualifications

• Preferred: prior experience in inside sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, customer service, or real estate (wholesaling / investor sales a plus).

• Required: excellent phone communication, reliable follow-through, and comfort working from scripts and a CRM.

• Tech: comfortable with CRM, dialer, and basic
/text tools; able to learn our systems quickly.

Key Performance Indicators

• Live-answer rate (target 90%+).

• Speed to lead — average response time on missed calls and web leads.

• Contact / conversion rate on new leads.

• Number of qualified appointments set per week.

• Appointment show-and-close rate handed off to acquisitions.

title: Freelance Paid Ads Specialist / Media Buyer (Meta, Google & TikTok Ads)

About the Role

We are an established company based in Leicester, UK, looking for a high-level Freelance Paid Ads Specialist / Media Buyer to architect and build our paid acquisition infrastructure.



This is a system setup and strategic monthly optimisation role, not a traditional, rigid in-house daily account management position. We need an expert who can build a high-performing ad engine, structure campaigns for aggressive testing, and provide monthly strategic optimisation.



Our internal team is highly capable and heavily focused on video production; TikTok is our main source of content. Your job is to deploy these assets across major ad networks for maximum ROI.



Scope of Work

Your responsibilities will be strictly focused on structural setup, advanced tracking, and high-level monthly ad optimisation:



Ad Channel Infrastructure: Architect and build clean, scalable campaign structures across Meta and Google Ads (including Google Shopping, Google Search, and YouTube Ads).



TikTok Integration (Major Plus): Leverage our heavy pipeline of TikTok-native content to set up, test, and optimise high-performing TikTok Ad campaigns.



Testing Structure: Set up ad accounts and campaign frameworks specifically engineered to rapidly test various products and video creatives.



Tracking & Attribution: Ensure pixel, conversion API, and UTM tracking are flawlessly configured for accurate ROI reporting across all platforms.



Monthly and Daily Optimisation: Analyse performance data, eliminate budget waste, scale winning creative angles, and consult on strategic pivots.



Note on Asset Production: You are responsible for account setup, campaign architecture, media buying, and tracking. You are not responsible for producing media assets. Our internal creative team will provide all high-quality videos, graphics, and copy to your exact specifications.



Compensation, Probation & Performance Guarantees

We are looking for a performance-driven professional who is confident in their ad strategies and willing to stand behind their execution.



Trial & Probation Period: The engagement will begin with a structured initial trial and probation period to assess collaboration, setup speed, and early performance metrics. (Pricing for the trial and probation period will be discussed during the interview stage and tailored to the final agreed scope).



SLA & ROI Guarantee: Long-term engagement will be tied to a strict Service Level Agreement (SLA) and a results-based ROI guarantee.



Risk/Reward Structure: We believe in rewarding excellence. If agreed-upon performance targets are met, compensation is highly lucrative. If targets are missed, compensation will be restricted to a set base amount strictly covering the baseline system setup costs.



The Market Rate: We expect a market-rate retainer or project fee structure commensurate with top-tier freelance media buying talent, scaled appropriately alongside the performance bonus.



Requirements

Proven case studies demonstrating cross-channel ad setup and management (Meta and Google Ads ecosystem).



Strong experience or deep familiarity with TikTok Ads (highly preferred, as TikTok is our primary content engine).



Masterful understanding of media buying, testing frameworks, and structuring campaigns built for rapid product/video testing.



Complete confidence in building campaigns optimised strictly for high ROI.



Total willingness to work under a performance-based SLA contract following a successful trial.



How to Apply

Please reply with the following details:



Your Experience: A brief summary of your freelance experience handling Meta and Google Ads media buying. Please highlight your experience with TikTok Ads and working with video-heavy content.



The ROI Framework: Your initial thoughts or preferred frameworks for structuring a performance-based ROI guarantee for paid ads.



Compensation Expectations: Your desired monthly Salary/rate for this optimisation and strategy scope (outside of the initial trial period).

title: Outbound sales calls
description:
# Appointment Setter (Inbound Warm Leads) – Restaurant Equipment Financing



**$5-$8/hour + Performance Bonuses**



We are looking for an experienced **Appointment Setter** to join our growing team. This is **NOT cold calling.** Every lead has already contacted us requesting information about commercial restaurant equipment financing.



Your job is to build rapport, qualify the prospect, educate them on our financing program, and schedule qualified appointments for our financing specialists.



## About Us



We help restaurant owners acquire **brand-new commercial restaurant equipment** through our lease-to-own financing program.



Unlike banks, we offer a fast, simple approval process with affordable monthly payments that allow restaurant owners to preserve cash flow while growing their business.



We finance **new equipment only** because buying used equipment often means buying someone else's repair bills, downtime, and headaches.



## Your Responsibilities



* Call inbound warm leads who requested information.

* Build genuine rapport with restaurant owners.

* Confirm they need commercial restaurant equipment.

* Explain our lease-to-own financing program in a clear, conversational manner.

* Educate prospects on the benefits of new equipment versus used equipment.

* Verify basic qualification information.

* Answer common questions professionally.

* Schedule qualified appointments for our financing specialists.

* Update our CRM accurately after every conversation.

* Follow up with prospects who requested callbacks.

* Represent our company with professionalism and enthusiasm.



## Requirements



* **Minimum 2 years of appointment setting experience (required).**

* Fluent English with **little to no accent.**

* Excellent verbal communication skills.

* Friendly, personable, and confident on the phone.

* Strong active listening skills.

* Ability to build trust quickly.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Quality headset and quiet home office.

* Comfortable using CRM software (GoHighLevel experience is a plus).

* Consistent attendance and punctuality.



## Ideal Candidate



You are someone who:



* Enjoys talking with people.

* Sounds natural—not like you're reading a script.

* Can keep conversations flowing.

* Knows how to ask good questions.

* Can overcome simple objections without being pushy.

* Is organized and detail-oriented.

* Wants a long-term position with room to grow.



## Compensation



* Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

* Performance bonuses for qualified appointments.

* Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. company.



## To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself.

3. A brief summary of your appointment-setting experience.

4. The CRM systems you've used.

5. Your internet speed test.

6. Your expected hourly rate.

7. Include the phrase **"Cash Flow Matters"** at the top of your application so we know you read this entire job posting.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Growth & Estimating Operations Specialist
description:
GROWTH & ESTIMATING OPERATIONS SPECIALIST

Remote  |  Full-time  |  Melbourne AEST hours





ABOUT JUGGERNAUT COATINGS

Juggernaut Coatings is a Melbourne-based commercial painting company scaling nationally. We're Dulux Accredited, MPA and MBA members, and back every job with a 5-year workmanship warranty. Our flagship projects include the Virgin VIP Lounge and Jetstar T4 Terminal at Melbourne Airport.

We're growing fast. We use AI to power our commercial painting quotes — and we're building a dedicated AI quoting bot to take that even further. We're expanding into Queensland where market rates are nearly double Melbourne. We're building a next-generation sales and operations engine — and we need a specialist to run it.





THE ROLE

This is a specialist commercial operations role. You'll own our estimating and quoting engine — running a daily raid on EstimateOne (Australia's leading construction tendering platform), processing 10-20 quotes per day, and getting them out the door with automated follow-up in place before you finish your morning.

You'll also be direct sales support to the Growth Director — managing inbound leads with strict speed-to-lead standards, monitoring quote enquiry inboxes, running cold outreach at volume across
 and LinkedIn, and working alongside our Digital Marketing Specialist to keep the entire sales machine humming.

This is not a virtual assistant role. This is a growth operations role for someone who genuinely enjoys the engine room of a fast-growing commercial business — the person who makes the pipeline flow, the CRM sing, and the sales director's day 3x more productive.





YOUR THREE PRIORITIES



PRIORITY 1 — OWN THE QUOTING PROCESS

Raid EstimateOne daily using a specific sequence — awarded projects, upcoming tenders, and systematic builder profile research.

Process 10-20 quotes per day. VIC first, expanding to QLD once VIC is running smoothly.

Run each quote through JC's AI-assisted quoting workflow, get the quote out same day, create the GoHighLevel opportunity, and trigger automated follow-up.

Every opportunity has contact details, notes, tasks, quote amount, and quote date — same day, no exceptions.





PRIORITY 2 — SALES SUPPORT & EA TO THE GROWTH DIRECTOR

Direct assistance on daily sales activities. Prepare his call list every morning. Log every conversation. Manage his post-call actions.

Speed-to-lead: once paid funnels launch, every inbound lead responded to within 5 minutes during business hours.

Monitor designated JC
 inboxes throughout the day for quote enquiries.

Work alongside the Digital Marketing Specialist to complete the post-quote and pre-quote follow-up sequences — critical to complete fast.





PRIORITY 3 — COLD OUTREACH & LEAD GENERATION

200+ personalised cold
s per week to commercial builders, strata managers, facility managers, hospitality operators, government, and infrastructure.

50+ LinkedIn touches per week to commercial decision-makers.

Data scraping to build target lists (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha, 
).

Running sequences via Lemlist (or similar) with campaigns designed by the Digital Marketing Specialist.

Database hygiene — protecting deliverability, preventing spam classification.







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Must-Have Experience

CRM experience — ideally GoHighLevel (GHL). You'll be in it every day, building opportunities, managing pipelines, triggering sequences. If you haven't used GHL specifically, similar CRM depth (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive) will be considered.

Cold
 at scale — you've run outreach campaigns before using Lemlist, Instantly, Smartlead, or similar tools. You understand deliverability, warm-up, bounce rates, and spam complaints.

Data scraping and list building — you know your way around LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha, or similar.

Excellent written English — every message you send represents JC. Copy quality matters.

Strong operational discipline — you finish what you start, log what you do, and never leave loose ends.

Time-zone availability — Melbourne AEST business hours are non-negotiable. This means 9:30am AEST start every working day.



Strong Plus

Experience in a commercial B2B or trades / construction context

Executive assistance or sales operations background

Prior work with paid funnels (Google Ads, Meta Ads) — you understand what speed-to-lead means for conversion

Copywriting or campaign-building experience — you won't be designing sequences from scratch, but you'll be executing them daily and iterating

Familiarity with EstimateOne, Xero, or Australian construction tendering platforms

AI tool proficiency (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) — used daily in the role





HOW YOU'LL WORK

Direct report to the Growth Director. Daily 10am Google Meet standup (camera on, no exceptions)

Working alongside the Digital Marketing Specialist. They own strategy, campaign design, and copy. You own execution, opportunity management, and daily operational use of GHL.

Coordinating with the estimating team (Dave) for optional review of AI-generated quotes

Weekly one-on-one review of KPIs, RAG scorecard, and pipeline progression

Three visibility artefacts: daily morning brief (before 10am), end-of-day report with a 2-3 min Loom walkthrough (before end of day), end-of-week summary (Friday or Saturday morning)





THE FOUR NON-NEGOTIABLES

These are written into the services agreement and are core requirements of the role:

Daily start at 9:30am AEST (Melbourne time). No exceptions.

10am AEST Google Meet standup with camera on. Every working day.

20-minute maximum response time to messages during working hours (5-min for funnel leads once live).

End-of-day reports Monday to Thursday. End-of-week summary Friday or Saturday morning. Every week.





COMPENSATION

Base salary — commercially competitive, structured for the specialist nature of the role. Salary confirmed with successful applicants.

Performance commission structure — kicks in from Month 3 for strong performers. Ties to KPI achievement, quote volume, and pipeline generation. No cap on commission.

Formal 3-month review with salary reassessment based on demonstrated performance.

Clear career pathway: Growth & Estimating Operations Specialist ? Senior Specialist ? Sales Operations Lead ? Head of Sales Operations.





HOW TO APPLY

Send a brief written application to 
 covering:

Your CRM experience — which platforms, how long, what you've built

A specific example of a cold outreach campaign you've run (target market, tools used, volume, results)

Your typical daily start time — confirm you can commit to a 9:30am AEST (Melbourne) start

Your commercial and B2B experience

Why this specific role appeals to you



Include the phrase 'JUGGERNAUT READY' as the first line of your
 so we know you read the brief carefully.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor

I run a content operation producing short-form videos at scale across multiple creator accounts. I need a reliable editor who can cut raw selfie-style recordings into polished, templated Reels/TikToks/Shorts — fast, consistent, and every single day.

Apply a consistent template: hook emphasis, punch-in/zoom cuts to kill dead air, clean animated captions, text overlays, arrows, simple b-roll/stock inserts

Add a standard end-screen call-to-action (provided) to every video

Deliver multiple finished videos per day on a predictable schedule



You're a fit if you:

Are fast in CapCut (or equivalent) and can hold a consistent style across dozens of videos

Have excellent English comprehension (you'll work from English scripts and need accurate captions)

Can commit to daily output and hit deadlines without being chased



Details:

Remote, ongoing, predictable daily volume

Paid every week via Wise

Style guide, reference videos, and end-screen assets all provided



To apply (read carefully): Start your message with "TIDEWATER" as the first word, or I won't read it. Then send: (1) links to 3 short-form videos you edited, (2) what tool do you use for editting and (3) your per-video rate for templated 30–60s edits. Applications missing any of these are deleted.

title: Property Manager

The portfolio currently includes approximately:



3 apartment communities with a total of approximately 135 apartments



Approximately 6 rental houses



A mini storage facility with approximately 281 units



Approximately 8 commercial properties with multiple suites in each



An office suites business with 9 monthly office suites



A new salon suites business



The owners are continuously developing, improving, and adding properties to the portfolio. The Property Manager must be able to help streamline processes, manage increasing responsibilities efficiently, maintain satisfactory occupancy, and deliver a professional tenant experience.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on U.S. property management experience, strong AppFolio experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Identify recurring problems, incomplete work, tenant concerns, vendor issues, occupancy issues, documentation gaps, and process failures, and take appropriate action to correct them.

Respond to incoming leads quickly and professionally by phone,
, text, and AppFolio.

Communicate with tenants, maintenance tea
mbers, vendors, janitorial providers, and management to make sure maintenance issues are handled efficiently and professionally.

Coordinate with management, maintenance, and vendors to ensure tenant communications are accurate and timely.



Move-Ins, Move-Outs, and Turnovers

Manage tenant communications, scheduling, documentation, keys, access devices, access codes, inspections, maintenance, cleaning, janitorial work, and final readiness.



Completely coordinate and oversee the full turnover process, making sure management, tenants, maintenance, janitorial, vendors, and other tea
mbers are scheduled, aligned, and kept updated.

Insurance, Lease Compliance, and Documentation

Follow up with tenants regarding missing, expired, incomplete, or noncompliant insurance documents.



Help enforce lease terms, property rules, insurance requirements, maintenance procedures, move-in requirements, move-out procedures, and company policies.



Maintain accurate notes, documents, communications, and records in AppFolio.



Asset and Warranty Tracking

Track property assets, including keys, garage clickers, access cards, remotes, fobs, codes, equipment, appliances, and other property-specific items.



Track maintenance-related assets and major repairs, including new HVAC units, appliances, equipment installations, roof repairs, plumbing repairs, electrical work, and other significant property improvements.

Assist tenants who are having trouble setting up or using the AppFolio tenant portal.

Lead response and follow-up



Leasing conversion and application processing



Work order follow-up and completion



Turnover timing and readiness



Insurance compliance



Timeliness and quality of tenant communication

Qualifications

Strong understanding of U.S. property management processes, including leasing, renewals, applications, credit and background checks, income verification, move-ins, move-outs, maintenance coordination, tenant communication, rent collection, notices, and documentation.

Ability to communicate professionally with tenants, prospects, owners, vendors, maintenance personnel, janitorial staff, and management.



Experience coordinating maintenance requests, vendor scheduling, tenant access, and work order follow-up through completion.



Highly organized with strong attention to detail.



Ability to track multiple tasks, deadlines, properties, tenants, vendors, work orders, applications, documents, and communications at the same time.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while keeping management properly updated.



Strong follow-through, accountability, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Comfortable using AppFolio, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace,
, calendars, spreadsheets, and task management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with office suites, salon suites, storage facilities, apartment communities, rental houses, and commercial suites.



Experience handling lease administration, tenant relations, rent collections, renewals, notices, move-ins, move-outs, and security deposit processing.

title: Ai Fashion Designer - UGC Generator
description:
We are a womenswear fashion brand focused on creating trend-driven, high-performing styles with strong commercial appeal. Our design process combines fashion direction, market awareness, and AI-powered tools to develop products that are visually strong, customer-focused, and positioned to sell in the US, Mexico, and Colombia markets. You can checkout our 



We are seeking an AI Fashion Designer who can quickly transform ideas, references, trends, and existing styles into new womenswear designs with strong selling potential. This role is not centered on artistic or conceptual fashion design. It is centered on creating commercially viable products that customers want to buy.



The ideal candidate must be highly skilled at using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Higgsfield, and other AI design platforms to generate, refine, and improve fashion concepts. You must be able to take an existing design and elevate it into a stronger version with better fit, more flattering details, stronger visual impact, and greater market appeal.



Daily responsibilities will include designing dresses, two-piece sets, skirts, tops, jumpsuits, and other womenswear categories. You will also be expected to create multiple variations from one core concept, including different colors, prints, cuts, silhouettes, sleeve styles, necklines, lengths, and fabric ideas. The ability to work quickly, follow direction, and think commercially is essential.



This role requires a strong understanding of fast fashion, trend-driven womenswear, and brands such as Fashion Nova, Zara, Revolve, and similar market leaders. You must understand how to design for different customer groups, especially US, Latina, and Black women. You should have a strong eye for what is flattering, desirable, photo-ready, and likely to convert into sales.



A solid understanding of garment construction is required. You must understand how clothing fits the body, how fabric behaves, and how stretch and non-stretch materials affect the final look and fit of a garment. You should be able to design pieces that enhance body shape, photograph well, look elevated, and meet customer expectations.



Attention to detail is extremely important. You must be able to follow specific instructions exactly, including design direction, fit requirements, fabric notes, color preferences, revision requests, and target customer details. Candidates who cannot carefully follow detailed instructions or complete revisions accurately will not be a good fit for this role.



As part of the application process, all candidates are required to submit 3 to 5 AI-generated womenswear designs. Each design submission must include:



• The design concept

• The target customer

• The AI tools used

• A clear explanation of why the design has strong selling potential



Applications submitted without these required design samples will not be considered.



This is a performance-based role with long-term growth opportunities for designers who can consistently create strong, trend-driven designs that convert into sales. We are looking for someone who can combine fashion taste, AI design skills, speed, accuracy, and commercial thinking to help us develop products customers are excited to buy.

title: Engineering Opportunity – Distribution Grid Projects

Scope of Work

Design of low- and medium-voltage electrical distribution networks

Engineering support for neighbourhood grid reinforcement (Buurt Aanpak projects)

Production and modification of CAD drawings according to NLCS++ (Dutch CAD Standard for Netbeheer)

Applicable Dutch Laws, Regulations & Standards



All work must comply with applicable Dutch and European regulations, including but not limited to:



Energiewet (Energy Act 2026) and associated regulatory framework

Netcode Elektriciteit (ACM regulated grid operation rules)

Electrical safety and installation standards such as NEN 1010 and NEN 4010

BEI-BLS safety regulations for electrical operational safety in low-voltage networks

NLCS++ CAD and data exchange standards for utility infrastructure

Additional Dutch grid operator “Plan of Requirements” (PvE) and technical design specifications

Applicable EU directives for grid connection and system safety



All engineers are expected to work in accordance with Dutch occupational safety law (Arbowet) and strict netbeheerder operational procedures.



Requirements

Experience in electrical infrastructure or civil utility engineering

Familiarity with European/Dutch grid compliance requirements

English proficiency required (Dutch is a plus)

Long-term infrastructure programs available

3–5 sample Midjourney images you've created (link to a Drive/portfolio)

Whether you have your own Midjourney subscription

Your rate and weekly availability

description:

At Skinnify (www.skinnify.co), we make clothing with built-in resistance — leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more — that turn everyday movements like walking, cooking, or commuting into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to 150,000+ customers – and we're just getting started.



To get a better idea of our company and what it's like to work on our team, check out this short video:



Now, we're looking for a full-time Graphic Designer (40 hours/week) to create world-class, high-converting creatives across paid advertising,
 marketing, social media, our website, and other customer touchpoints. You'll play a key role in shaping our brand, improving conversion rates, and helping millions of women discover a new way to stay fit.



???? Your Responsibilities

? Design high-converting static creatives for
, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Google Display, and other paid advertising platforms

? Create compelling landing page graphics, website banners, and promotional materials

? Design product visuals, mockups, packaging concepts, and marketing materials that align with our premium brand

? Work closely with creative strategists, copywriters, media buyers, video editors, and CRO specialists to bring campaign ideas to life

? Develop engaging social media content that strengthens Skinnify's brand presence

? Maintain and evolve our visual identity across all channels while ensuring brand consistency

? Organize design files, templates, and creative assets for efficient collaboration

? Continuously improve creatives based on performance data, A/B testing, and customer feedback



???? What We're Looking For

?? Excellent Graphic Design Skills – Strong understanding of typography, composition, color theory, layout, and branding

?? DTC E-commerce Experience – Experience creating high-performing creatives for ecommerce brands (fashion, fitness, beauty, or consumer products is a big plus)

?? Advanced Design Software Skills – Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar professional design tools

?? Performance-Driven Mindset – You understand that great design should not only look beautiful but also drive conversions

?? Creative Problem Solver – Able to translate marketing ideas into compelling visual concepts

?? Attention to Detail – Pixel-perfect execution with consistently high-quality work

?? Collaborative Yet Independent – Comfortable receiving feedback while taking ownership of your projects

?? Organized & Reliable – Able to manage multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines



???? Why Join Skinnify?

???? Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your designs will directly influence our growth and customer experience.

???? Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One tea
mber went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

???? Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking—as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

???? Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls—we cover it. Many tea
mbers book calls with founders of big ecommerce brands or managers at major companies through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co.

?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore, and actually get to know each other. Here is a video of our last company retreat: 

? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor (
)



???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.



????? Our Products

What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.



???? Skinnify's Core Values

???? Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone — even the busiest and least motivated.

???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

? Quality – Our products are built to last — high-quality, durable, and reliable.



Ready to design creatives that inspire millions and drive real business growth? Apply now and let's build the future of fitness together.
