title: Full Stack Marketer
description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems. 



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the entire marketing engine of an established, fast-growing company. Where most assistants own one lane — content, funnels, or ads — you'll own the full stack: turning ideas into content, content into leads, leads into booked calls, and data into decisions. Working directly with the Founder, you'll execute with precision across social media, copywriting, funnel operations, and paid ads — with AI built into every layer of your workflow to 10x your output. You won't just support growth — you'll be the one person the Founder trusts to run the machine end to end.



***Role Responsibilities



Content Creation & Copywriting

- Leverage AI to research market trends, viral content references, and competitor creatives, compiling findings into concise content idea lists and creative briefs.

- Set up Claude/AI writing projects with accurate instructions and context files (brand voice, ICP, offer docs) to produce brand-aligned first drafts.

- Write and refine platform-native copy: reel titles and captions, carousels, talking-head scripts, long-form articles, and
 sequences (welcome, opt-in, and pre-call nurture).

- Repurpose long-form videos into platform-native outputs: short-form reels, LinkedIn articles, blogs, and
 content.



Video & Graphic Design

- Transform raw talking-head footage into engaging short-form reels with accurate cuts, pacing, captions, hooks, and b-roll overlays.

- Design graphics, quote cards, carousels, thumbnails, and lead magnets in alignment with brand guidelines.

- QA all content and assets before publication — links, captions, formatting, mobile view, and brand voice.



Social Media & Audience Management

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across platforms.

- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions; pre-qualify leads and route them toward booked calls.

- Set up ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Manage outreach and DM conversations from first touch through opt-in, follow-up, and post-webinar sequences.



Funnel & CRM Operations (GoHighLevel)

- Set up GHL sub-accounts from scratch: domains,
/SMS (with A2P verification), custom fields, and snapshots.

- Build and customize lead magnet and VSL funnels, including forms, calendars, integrations, and automated
/SMS sequences.

- Maintain CRM hygiene: contact tagging, smartlist segmentation, pipeline staging, and automated opportunity triggers.

- QA every funnel end to end on desktop and mobile before publishing.



Meta Ads Support

- Research competitor ads and messaging angles; format and publish static and video ad creatives.

- Set up lead ad forms, campaigns, custom/lookalike audiences, pixels, and Conversion API with GoHighLevel.

- Monitor campaign metrics daily and flag anomalies (spend spikes, tracking discrepancies) immediately.



Tracking, Reporting & Ownership

- Set up tracking across Meta Pixels, Conversion API, Google Analytics, and UTMs; troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms.

- Build dashboards and trackers that accurately report performance across content, funnels, and ad campaigns.

- Deliver weekly reports that end with insight and recommendation — what worked, likely why, and what to kill, scale, or test next — never just numbers.

- When a metric lags behind target, flag it to the Founder with a proposed fix rather than reporting and moving on.



Systems & Documentation

- Use AI to document recurring tasks into clear SOPs, process maps, and shareable snapshots so execution becomes faster and repeatable.

- Proactively identify workflow bottlenecks and propose AI or automation solutions to increase output.



Role Requirements

- Minimum 3 years virtual work experience in marketing execution (agency experience highly preferred).

- Excellent written and spoken English — able to match a founder's brand voice in client-facing copy.

- Proven experience with GoHighLevel at agency and sub-account levels.

- Proficient in video editing (CapCut, Descript, or DaVinci Resolve) and graphic design (Canva, Photoshop, or Figma) — portfolio required.

- Experience managing
, Instagram, and LinkedIn pages; ManyChat experience preferred.

- Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, and UTM tracking.

- Confident and proactive in leveraging AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity across daily workflows.

- Self-starter with extreme ownership: flags problems before being asked, brings solutions to problems, and never marks a task done that isn't.

- Detail-obsessed: sends test
s before broadcasts, previews funnels on mobile, and checks every link before anything goes live.

- Comfortable communicating with sophisticated entrepreneurs, with strong verbal and video presentation.



Role Results (KPIs)

- 100% adherence to content production calendar (edited, approved, scheduled).

- ?95% QA pass rate across submitted content, funnels, and automations — minimal factual, formatting, or brand-voice errors.

- 100% GHL CRM hygiene — well-maintained pipelines, tags, workflows, and campaigns.

- ?95% reporting accuracy across campaign tracking (Meta Pixel, UTM, Google Analytics).

- <30-minute response time to social media interactions, lead outreach opportunities, and Founder messages during shifts.

- Weekly performance reports delivered on time, each with at least one actionable recommendation.

- Measurable growth in audience engagement and lead generation quarter over quarter.



Work Schedule

- Full-time position. 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- Exact shift times based on the founder's timezone — may require working across North American, European, or 

- Australia/Asia Pacific time zones.

- Availability may be required around key publishing windows and campaign launches.

- Compensation Structure and Perks

- Competitive salary starting at 860 USD / month

- Eligibility to earn quarterly bonuses of up to 1,600 USD per year.

- Pay rise potential according to experience and performance.

- Opportunity to be hired for projects at higher one-off fees on top of standard salary.



***HOW TO APPLY:

If you meet all the above requirements and are confident that you are a great fit for this position, submit your application by clicking on the following link:

If you are looking to work in a dynamic, multi-entity, and internationally exposed accounting environment, this is an opportunity to be considered for future roles aligned with your experience level.



Shortlisted candidates will be contacted as soon as suitable client engagements become available.



Who This Pool Is For



We are looking for professionals who want to grow and contribute within:

• Global accounting operations

• Multi-entity environments

• Cross-border reporting structures

• High-performance finance teams



This pool includes potential roles such as:

• GL Accountant

• Senior Accountant

• Accounting Supervisor / Team Lead

• Accounting Manager



Role Overview

Depending on the client requirement and your experience level, you may take on either:

Execution-focused responsibilities

Oversight and leadership responsibilities

Close ownership and reporting roles



You will support organizations that value accuracy, accountability, and process improvement.



Key Responsibilities

(May vary depending on level)



General Ledger & Close

• Manage and maintain accurate general ledger records

• Prepare and/or review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

• Ensure proper accounting for fixed assets



Financial Analysis & Reporting

• Assist in financial reporting preparation

• Support audit activities and documentation



Multi-Entity & Global Support

• Act as a point of contact for assigned business units or entities

• Coordinate with AP, AR, Payroll, and Finance teams

• Support cross-functional finance operations



Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities for process optimization

• Contribute to improving close timelines

• Support documentation of accounting workflows



Senior / Manager-Level Responsibilities

For more experienced professionals:

• Review work of junior accountants

• Manage close timelines and reporting accuracy

• Support accounting policy implementation

• Partner with Finance leadership

• Coordinate accounting deliverables across teams



Experience Levels We Welcome

• 3+ years – Accountant Level

• 5+ years – Senior Accountant Level

• 7+ years – Accounting Supervisor / Manager Level



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance

• Strong understanding of US GAAP

• Experience with month-end close and reconciliations

• ERP experience (NetSuite or similar preferred)

• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong attention to detail and time management



Preferred Experience

• Exposure to US, AU, or Singapore entities

• Multi-entity or multi-currency environments

• Audit support experience

• CPA or equivalent certification

• Experience mentoring or leading accounting teams



Application Instructions

- Your application letter

- Unrestricted link to your updated resume/CV



Subject Line:

AccountingPool – YOUR FULL NAME

title: Senior GL Accountant (US Focus)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior GL Accountant to support US-focused accounting and finance operations within a fast-paced and high-performance environment.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting, with a solid understanding of US GAAP and multi-entity accounting operations.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are confident working independently, partnering cross-functionally, and operating within process-driven finance environments that value accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting environments

• Multi-entity operations

• Cross-functional finance teams

• High-volume and fast-paced close cycles

• Process-driven accounting environments

• Roles requiring strong ownership and accountability



Role Overview



The Senior GL Accountant will take ownership of key accounting functions including:

• General ledger management

• Month-end and year-end close

• Financial reporting support

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Audit preparation and compliance

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures and cross-functional finance operations.



Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Close

• Own and manage assigned general ledger accounts

• Prepare and review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

Revenue and expense adjustments



• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Maintain accurate supporting schedules and audit-ready workpapers

• Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial records



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Support preparation of monthly financial reports and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and flux analysis with clear explanations

• Assist with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis

• Ensure proper cutoff and period-end accuracy



Technical Accounting & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies

• Support internal and external audit activities

• Maintain strong internal controls and documentation standards

• Review transactions for proper accounting treatment

title: Appointment Setter (Clear US Accent Required): Warm Bathroom Remodeling Leads: Extremely High Earning Potential
description:
We run ads for bathroom remodeling companies across the US. Leads click our ad, get fully qualified, and are told someone will call them. Your job is to call them fast, run a short script, and book them on our client's calendar. That's it.

These are warm leads. They just raised their hand and they're expecting your call. You are not cold calling anyone.

We're looking for a killer. Someone who shows up to dominate, hits the phone hard, and wants to book as many appointments as possible because every booking is more money in your pocket. If you're the type who's happy doing the bare minimum, this isn't for you. If you're hungry and want to earn, keep reading.

What you'll do:



Watch a Slack channel during your shift for new lead notifications

Call the lead within 5 minutes of the notification (speed is the whole game here)

Open the right client's CRM, go to the Opportunities tab, hit call

Follow the script (it's in the CRM and in Slack)

Re-qualify and book the appointment on the client's GHL calendar

Done



The script and everything you need is provided. You are not building anything or figuring anything out. You call, follow the script, book.

What we need:



A clear American accent. This is non-negotiable. You're calling US homeowners and they need to feel comfortable on the phone. If there's any noticeable accent, this isn't the right role for you.

Real sales or phone experience. You can hold a conversation, handle a little hesitation, and get someone on the calendar.

A closer mindset. You want to win, you want the commissions, and you treat every lead like money on the table.

Reliable and fast. When a lead comes in, you're on it inside 5 minutes.

Good internet and a quiet place to call from.



Pay:



$7.50 for every appointment you book

We expect a booking rate of at least 35% of the leads you call. Leads are warm and the script works, so the more you grind, the more you earn. No cap.



We're starting slower, around 5 to 15 leads a day to call, and it's ramping fast. So I'm not looking for someone just to fill a seat. I need someone who is ready now, has the experience, and wants to be here a while and grow with us as the volume climbs. You'll handle leads across all our clients from one seat, so we want someone who can own it. We're hiring one person right now.

To apply:



Send a 60 to 90 second voice note. This is required. No voice note means you will not be considered at all, no exceptions. It's how we hear your accent and how you'd actually sound on the phone with our leads, so make it good.

After the voice note, the next step is a quick 5 minute call where I'll gauge your ability. If it's a fit, we onboard you fast and get you into the flow right away.

We move quick here, so if you're ready to start earning, send that voice note now.

title: Hiring a Remote Product Research Analyst (Amazon FBA Wholesale)
description:
Join a remote team scaling a wholesale Amazon FBA business across the UK and EU. We’re hiring an experienced Product Research Analyst to find high-quality, profitable wholesale products that help fuel our growth.



---



About Us



We’re a fast-growing wholesale eCommerce company using Amazon FBA, focused on ambient international groceries - mainly food, plus select health and personal care items. We sell across the UK and key EU markets like Germany, France, Italy and Spain.



Our growth is driven by discovering excellent wholesale opportunities and quickly inbounding them into relevant high-performing Amazon listings. We focus on data-backed research, efficient sourcing, and strong supplier relationships - and we’re looking for a product development analyst who feels like that is the right environment for them.



---



The Role:



You will be responsible for consistently sourcing new, profitable SKUs that match our criteria from new/existing wholesale suppliers. This role is 100% focused on FBA wholesale - not arbitrage or private label.



You’ll use tools like Keepa, SmartScout, Helium10 and our own internal software to find opportunities. You will liaise directly with suppliers for pricelists/offers/catalogues, and document new SKUs ready for handoff to our supply chain team.



You’ll work directly with the business owner and our supply chain manager and be expected to produce consistently high-quality sourcing output each week.



---



Key Responsibilities



Product Research & Sourcing

- Analyse wholesale catalogues against Amazon data to identify winning SKUs

- Use a variety of sourcing techniques to produce a consistent flow of leads that meet our criteria

- Use tools like Keepa, Helium10, and SmartScout to validate demand, margin, pricing history and any red flags

- Research Amazon marketplaces to find potential brands or suppliers to add to our network

- Work with the owner to continue development of our own sourcing software to further systemise your own work



Documentation & Handover

- Fill out a product sourcing proforma (SKU, cost price, supplier details, quantity, etc.)

- Provide relevant notes on compliance (hazmat, expiry, FBA prep needs)

- Communicate clearly with the Supply Chain Manager and Owner in case of any queries



---



What We’re Looking For



Required Experience & Skills

- Minimum 3 years of experience in Amazon FBA wholesale product research

- Proficient in Google Sheets and Excel (VLOOKUP, INDEX, basic formulas, filtering)

- Advanced user of Keepa, Helium10, or SmartScout

- Strong understanding of FBA prep requirements, IP risks, and potential compliance issues

- Ability to think creatively and find new ways of sourcing products for the UK & EU Amazon marketplaces



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience sourcing grocery/FMCG SKUs (non-perishable food, health items)

- Background in sourcing for the UK and EU marketplaces



---



Ideal Candidate Traits



- Data-Driven and Analytical:

    You make sourcing decisions based on real, validated data rather than instinct. You’re confident using software tools to evaluate sales rank, price history, offer count and FBA fees. You can justify your recommendations with evidence.

    

- Detail-Oriented and Risk-Aware:

    You catch issues that others might overlook such as a product with incorrect branding, an IP complaint risk or hazmat classification. You flag risks before they cause problems.

    

- Clear and Proactive Communicator:

    You communicate clearly and professionally with suppliers and colleagues; whether it's requesting a price list or following up for missing information. Internally, you document your findings in a way that’s easy for others to understand without clarification.

    

- Self-Sufficient and Ownership-Minded:

    You don’t need extensive monitoring to stay productive. You can structure your own time and solve problems independently. You take personal responsibility for the quality of your sourcing. You understand that some days may produce fewer finds, but you aim for long-term weekly consistency

    

- Strategically Curious:

    You want to understand why some products work and others don’t. You look for patterns, revisit old listings, cross-reference regions, and suggest new tactics when needed. You enjoy improving your sourcing skills.



---



Compensation & Benefits



- Salary: $1,000 USD/month base + performance bonuses

- 100% Remote

- Join a fast-growing Amazon FBA business

- Learn from a team with deep experience in EU/UK wholesale

- Significant room for growth as part of a lean, high-performance team



---



How to Apply

title: Managing Editor at Headphonesty
description:
**About us**

Headphonesty (
) is an independent publication covering personal audio, read by millions of readers every month worldwide. Our readers found us in their
 and Google feeds, which means every one of those visits was earned by a headline and an angle strong enough to stop a stranger mid-scroll. That craft is the heart of this role. 



We're a small, fully remote team that's been publishing for years and isn't going anywhere. 



Same timezone as Singapore.



**The role**

You'll own each article's journey from approved lead all the way to a published article that people actually read. The core skill isn't proofreading; it's packaging: taking a subject that looks dry on paper (a patent filing, a wear-test study, an industry pricing change) and finding the story angle that makes people click, without stretching the truth. 



Around that craft sits a pipeline you'll run day to day, working directly under our Editor-in-Chief: assign topics to writers, edit drafts to publish-ready, brief our thumbnail designer, publish on WordPress, and distribute on
. 



When the Editor-in-Chief is away, the pipeline runs on your watch.



**What you'll do**

 >> Own the angle. Leads arrive with a proposed angle; it's your call to run it, sharpen it, or replace it before the writer starts

 >> Edit drafts to publish-ready: structure, flow, accuracy, and voice

 >> Train on our headline craft. Final titles are currently written by the Editor-in-Chief; you'll study what makes them perform, draft titles for every article, and earn ownership of the final call. We have a playbook. You bring the taste.

 >> Fact-check rigorously, including catching wrong or suspicious product specs

 >> Coordinate with our thumbnail designer to create a scroll-stopping thumbnail for every article

 >> Distribute articles on our
 page, re-push strong performers, and learn from what clicks

 >> Learn topic selection from the Editor-in-Chief over time



**What success looks like**

 >> Month 1: you do first-pass edits plus angle and title reps on every article; the Editor-in-Chief reviews everything

 >> By ~2 months: you own our full weekly pipeline (~8-10 articles/week), with the Editor-in-Chief sampling for quality

 >> Always: the articles you package get read. A flawlessly edited article that nobody clicks is a miss here. We measure performance, not just output.



This is a role with a real ramp and real ownership at the end of it, not a proofreading gig.



**You're a fit if you have**

 >> A knack for making true things irresistible: you can look at a boring-but-solid subject and see the angle and headline that earn the click (the application asks you to prove this on the spot)

 >> Proven editing experience: in your application you'll share work you edited, not wrote

 >> Excellent written English and sharp judgment about facts and claims

 >> Working familiarity with WordPress,
 pages, and basic analytics (the tools are trainable; the taste isn't)

 >> A smart approach to AI editing tools: you use them, and you know where not to trust them

 >> Interest in headphones/audio (a plus, not required)

 >> Availability for full-time work as a remote contractor with Singapore-timezone overlap



**Pay and process**

$1,000–1,400/month USD base, depending on experience. 



On top of that, there is a monthly performance bonus: once the articles you run cross our traffic thresholds, you earn a revenue share paid per thousand pageviews, in rising tiers. Your packaging skill directly raises your own pay, and in strong traffic months the bonus adds meaningfully to the base. 



Full bonus mechanics are shared with shortlisted candidates.



Our process: application form ? short async questions for shortlisted candidates ? paid test task ($30–50) ? final interview with the Editor-in-Chief. We respond to every shortlisted candidate.



** How to apply **

Apply through this form only: 



Read the form's instructions carefully; applications that don't follow them are not reviewed.

title: Head of Customer Support For DTC Ecom Brand
description:
We are a fast scaling DTC Ecom Brand and we need to hire a Head of Support for our CX team.



You'll own

- The team: our CX agents today, and everyone you hire after — weekly KPIs per rep, QA ticket audits, coaching, and a bonus structure you design

- Systems from scratch: scenario playbooks ("when this comes up, here's what you do"), macros, escalation trees, tone guidelines, refund & save decision rights — your SOPs become the operating manual

- The review trajectory: engineered review flows, negative-review interception, response protocol. The Trustpilot number is yours

- Save & refund economics: cancellation saves and the save-offer ladder, with our Head of Retention

- Chargeback prevention: resolving customers before they call their bank — you protect our processor health

- Three intelligence loops: monthly insight reports to product (quality themes), creative (customer objections become ads), and fulfillment (shipping patterns flagged same-week)

- Ticket deflection: we're tripling volume — that must not mean tripling headcount. Self-serve, proactive comms, AI triage: the ticket-per-order ratio is your scaling metric

- Q4 readiness: surge staffing, macros, and i
 protocols in place before November



Who you are

- You've led CX at a DTC/e-commerce brand doing $3M+/month (or equivalent ticket volume) — you've seen real scale, surge seasons, and processor stakes

- You've built support systems from scratch, not inherited them — and you can show us the SOPs, decision trees, and QA rubrics you made

- You have a review-score or CSAT turnaround you personally drove, with numbers

- You've hired, coached, and exited reps — built a team, not just supervised one

- You know your ticket-per-order ratio and what you did to move it (if you've never computed it, this isn't your role)

- You use AI where it multiplies (triage, drafting, tagging) and keep humans where it matters (skin reactions, angry customers, disputes)

- You're still happy to work the queue on the hardest tickets — this is player-coach, not pure management



Comp & structure

$2,000–$4,000/month base (experience-dependent) · full-time · fully remote, global

Quarterly performance bonus up to $2,000, recurring — four metrics at $500 each: CSAT, save rate, chargeback rate, Trustpilot trajectory. Hit all four every quarter, get paid every quarter

Record a 3-minute Loom covering: (1) the best support function you've ever built and one artifact from it, (2) your last roles and why you left or planning to,

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:
# Job Title: Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager- Minimum 7 years of experience required, and willing to work Eastern Standard Time; responsible, reliable, able to deliver results, and has worked exclusively on Amazon Seller Central. Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management



* Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central, excluding PPC.

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



  * Amazon SEO and listing structure

  * Parent-child variations

  * Flat files and bulk uploads

  * Listing suppression issues

  * Inventory file templates

  * Seller Central troubleshooting

  * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Strong understanding of how listing images, A+ content, and brand storytelling affect conversion.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Catalog issues, suppressed listings, and operational problems are resolved quickly and proactively.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

* Product launches and updates are executed accurately and efficiently.

* The Amazon storefront reflects a polished, premium European home décor brand experience.



## To Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction outlining your Amazon Seller Central experience.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

4. Any experience working with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or lifestyle brands.

5. Your availability and preferred compensation structure.



## Important Note



This role is **not for PPC or advertising management**. We are specifically seeking an Amazon professional who excels in **listing management, catalog optimization, and overall Seller Central account management**.

title: Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality)
description:
About Us

We’re building a global talent pool of exceptional remote Medical Scribes / Documentation QA Specialists to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative care, and allied health support.



Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—by supporting clinicians with accurate, consistent documentation so patients receive safe, continuous care and clinics can operate with confidence.



If you’re detail-oriented, privacy-minded, and love creating clean, clinician-ready charts, we’d love to meet you.



Role Overview

As a Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality), you’ll help ensure patient charts are complete, accurate, and easy for clinicians to use. Depending on clinic assignment, your work may include real-time or near-real-time scribing during telehealth visits, post-visit documentation cleanup, and ongoing chart audits to maintain consistent standards.



This is a pooling/talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to open roles with clinics based on:

 • Your scribing and documentation experience (telehealth, in-person, specialty exposure)

 • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US)

 • EHR systems you’ve used (or your ability to learn quickly)

 • Compensation alignment and expected workload volume

Note: You do not provide medical advice. You support documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and compliance-minded recordkeeping.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 • Create or refine visit documentation using clinic templates (e.g., SOAP, HPI, ROS, assessment, plan, patient instructions).

 • Scribe during or immediately after telehealth visits when assigned (accurate, concise, clinician-ready).

 • QA charts for completeness: required fields, signatures, coding support fields (if applicable), and follow-up tasks.

 • Standardize formatting and terminology while preserving the clinician’s intent and clinical accuracy.

 • Ensure documentation supports continuity of care: clear next steps, follow-up timelines, and patient education notes.

 • Flag missing information or documentation risks to clinicians using a structured escalation workflow.

 • Maintain consistent use of tags, problem lists, medication lists, allergies, and history updates (per policy).

 • Support clinic documentation standards: macros, templates, smart phrases, and style guides.

 • Perform periodic chart audits (sample-based) and report trends: common misses, training needs, template gaps.

 • Coordinate asynchronously with clinicians and ops teams for corrections and handoffs.

 • Protect patient privacy and follow confidentiality/security practices at all times.



Must-Have Qualifications

 • 3+ years of experience in medical scribing, clinical documentation, medical transcription, chart auditing, or similar healthcare documentation roles.

 • Strong written English with excellent grammar and ability to summarize accurately.

 • Familiarity with medical terminology and common documentation structures (SOAP, HPI, etc.).

 • High attention to detail—able to spot inconsistencies, missing fields, and documentation gaps.

 • Comfort working inside EHR/EMR systems and following structured templates.

 • Ability to work fast without sacrificing accuracy, especially under time pressure.

 • Strong privacy mindset (healthcare confidentiality, minimum necessary access, secure handling).

 • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and proactive communication.

 • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, stable internet, and secure device practices.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Telehealth scribing experience (live or near-live).

 • Experience with any EHR/EMR (e.g., Best Practice, Halaxy, SimplePractice, Athena, DrChrono, Kareo, Practice Better, etc.).

 • Experience supporting multiple specialties (primary care, allied health, integrative care, mental health, pain, sleep).

 • Familiarity with documentation compliance expectations and chart audit processes.

 • Exposure to ICD-10/CPT basics or clinical coding support (not required; depends on clinic assignment).

 • Strong template-building skills (macros, smart phrases, standard note formats).

 • Experience working with international teams and time zone handoffs.



Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

 • EHR/EMR: any system (training provided per clinic); comfort learning new workflows quickly

 • Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack/Teams, Notion/Trello/Asana

 • Documentation aids: approved templates, smart phrases/macros (clinic-specific)

 • Voice (if used): VoIP platforms for live visits (clinic-specific)



Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Location: Philippines (remote)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clear async updates.



Compensation (General Guidance)

Starts at USD 10/hour. Higher rates may apply for:

 • strong scribing track record (telehealth/live)

 • demonstrated QA/auditing experience

 • speed + accuracy at volume

 • experience building documentation templates/macros

Some clinics may offer incentives based on accuracy and turnaround time.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your documentation/scribing background

 • EHR systems you’ve used (or how you learn new ones fast)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

 • Your approach to accuracy, privacy, and fast turnaround

 3. Optional but strongly recommended: 1–2 anonymized writing samples (remove all identifying/patient data), such as:

 • a sample SOAP note you created, or

 • a “before/after” documentation cleanup example



Important: Do not submit any document containing real patient identifiers.



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Initial screen (English writing + documentation experience + remote readiness)

 • Practical test (timed): create a structured note from a mock transcript + QA checklist

 • Structured interview: scenarios on accuracy, privacy, clinician collaboration, and handling missing info



Join the Pool

If you take pride in clean charts, love structured work, and want to help clinicians deliver better care through excellent documentation, we’d love to hear from you.

 • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, headset, stable internet, and backup plan.

 • Willingness to work shifts overlapping AU/UK/US/NZ depending on assignment.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Experience selling or booking for healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or subscription services.

Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clean handoffs.



Compensation (General Guidance)

 • bonus per qualified appointment booked

 • bonus per attended appointment (show rate)

 • monthly performance bonus for hitting targets

Details vary by clinic and will be confirmed during matching.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your cold calling/sales background (industry + results)

 • Your best achievement (e.g., appointments booked/week, conversion rate, revenue)

 • Tools you’ve used (CRM/dialer/SMS/email)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

Important: Applications missing the required CV + video may not be considered.



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Practical task: short role-play + CRM note sample + follow-up message draft

 • Structured interview: scenarios on objection handling, ethics, and performance consistency



Join the Pool

If you’re persuasive without being pushy, love the rhythm of outbound calls, and want to help more people access care, we’d love to hear from you.

nt.

ntum throughout the entire vlog.

nts and create energy.

- Ability to build compelling narratives from large amounts of footage.

- Understanding of YouTube analytics and how editing impacts watch time.

nts are amplified, while slower

title: Performance Video Editor | Remote | Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand
description:
Performance Video Editor | Remote | Fast-Growing DTC Health Brand



We usually respond to thoughtful applications within one business day.



We are hiring video editor(s) for a fast-growing DTC health brand building a serious performance creative team.



This is not a basic editing role.



We are looking for an editor who understands attention, pacing, retention, storytelling, hooks, product trust, and direct-response creative. Someone who can take a brief, a reference, raw assets, and real-world constraints, then turn them into a clean ad that is actually ready to launch.



If you are a top-tier editor, you probably already know your worth.



Good. We want people with taste, speed, ownership, and the confidence to communicate clearly when something can be better.



ROLE DETAILS



- Remote / worldwide

- Fast-paced performance creative team

- Short-form ads, UGC-style ads, VSL-style creatives, product videos, hooks, and cutdowns

- Long-term growth path for people who perform



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Edit launch-ready paid social ads for Meta, TikTok, Reels, and other platforms

- Build strong hooks, cutdowns, variations, and performance-focused edits

- Improve pacing, clarity, retention, captions, visual rhythm, and CTA flow

- Review briefs, references, assets, and notes before cutting

- Catch issues before final export: wrong products, bad audio, weak clips, awkward cuts, off-sync captions, missing assets, or anything that makes the ad feel unlaunchable

- Suggest better creative decisions when you see a stronger path

- Communicate early when something is unclear, broken, late, or needs a better solution



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You might be a fit if you have:



- Strong editing taste and visual judgment

- Sharp pacing, retention, and storytelling instincts

- Experience with short-form ads, UGC, ecommerce, YouTube, VSLs, or creator content

- Strong English comprehension

- Good attention to detail

- A fast but careful editing workflow

- Comfort using AI tools or willingness to learn fast

- Clear communication and high ownership

- The ability to follow references closely without losing your own creative taste



Experience with ecommerce, DTC, health, wellness, direct-response, or paid ads is a major plus.



But if your work is strong and your fundamentals are sharp, apply anyway. Proof beats pedigree here.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



A lot of editing roles treat editors like button-pushers.



This one does not.



We want creative operators: people who can think, execute, catch mistakes, improve the final product, and help raise the creative standard over time.



The right person can grow into higher-responsibility roles like Senior Editor, Lead Editor, Creative Strategist, UGC Manager, or Creative Lead as the team grows.



This is a long-term role at a long-term company. We are building for years, not weeks.



HOW WE OPERATE



Quality first. Speed second. Communication always.



We prefer early communication over silence. If something is unclear, broken, missing, late, or likely to hurt the final ad, say it early.



No fake corporate theater. No ego games. No disappearing when something gets hard.



We want direct, practical, hungry people who care about making the creative win.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



- Competitive compensation based on skill, reliability, and output

- Remote work

- Long-term growth path

- Real ownership and autonomy

- Direct feedback that makes you better

- Mentorship and investment in your creative, technical, and strategic growth

- Additional benefits can be discussed based on your needs



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:





Do not send a generic copy-paste message.



Fill out the form properly. Include your best work, editing examples, tools, availability, and a clear breakdown of why one of your edits worked.



At the end of the form, write LFG so we know you read everything.



Thoughtful applications are usually reviewed within one business day.

description:

Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hours

At Pierian, we help Australian mortgage brokers scale their businesses through highly skilled offshore teams, streamlined operations, and AI-powered solutions. 



The Senior Mortgage Analyst is responsible for managing and strengthening long-term relationships with Australian mortgage broker clients following successful onboarding by the Transition Team. Combining strong Australian mortgage expertise with operational leadership, this role ensures clients continue to receive exceptional service, achieve operational efficiencies, and maximize the value of their offshore team. Working closely with brokers and internal teams, you will monitor operational performance, resolve challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and provide strategic recommendations that support client growth and retention. This role is ideal for experienced Australian mortgage professionals looking to move beyond day-to-day loan processing into a client-facing operational leadership position.

Operational Consulting

> Promote the adoption of best practices, automation, and AI-powered operational solutions where appropriate.  

> Identify opportunities to expand services based on client needs and business growth. 



Cross-Functional Collaboration 

> Work closely with the Transition Manager to ensure a seamless handover following implementation.  

> Partner with Operations Managers, Team Leaders, Recruitment, and Leadership to support client success.  

> Maintain accurate client records, meeting notes, action plans, and operational reports. 

 



You Must Have 

> Minimum 5 years of experience working within an Australian mortgage brokerage or lending environment.  

> Extensive knowledge of Australian residential lending processes from application through settlement.  

> Strong understanding of lender policies, NCCP compliance, and mortgage operations.

> Strong stakeholder management and client relationship skills.

Account Manager
